outcomes.final:
SUMMARY: The customer was charged twice for their Pro plan this month. The ticket has been assigned to the Billing Team for a refund.
DRAFT REPLY: Thank you for bringing this to our attention. We will process a refund for the extra charge. Please provide the dates and amounts of both charges for a faster resolution. Refunds typically take 5 to 10 business days to appear on your card. If you have any questions, feel free to open a new ticket with the Billing Team.

SUMMARY: The customer is experiencing issues with their two-factor authentication code being rejected. The ticket has been assigned to the Account Support team for further assistance.
DRAFT REPLY: Thank you for reaching out. The most common cause for a rejected code is a clock that's not set to the correct time on your phone. Please ensure your device's clock is set to automatic time. If the issue persists, we can help you with one of your backup codes or verify your identity to turn off 2FA temporarily.

SUMMARY: The customer needs to change their password, sign out of all devices, and enable two-factor authentication to secure their account. The ticket has been assigned to the Security Team and escalated to a manager due to the potential security incident.

DRAFT REPLY: Thank you for bringing this to our attention. We are escalating this to our Security Team and a manager to ensure your account is secured as quickly as possible. Please change your password, sign out of all devices, and enable two-factor authentication. If you need any assistance, please let us know.

SUMMARY: The customer wants to know how to import projects from Excel, and the help article indicates this can be done through the Projects > Import feature. The ticket has been assigned to the Technical Support team.

DRAFT REPLY: Hi there! To import your projects from Excel, go to Projects > Import and upload your .xlsx or .csv file. The first row should contain the column names. If you need more detailed steps, our Technical Support team will be happy to help. Thanks!

SUMMARY: The entire team is experiencing a product outage where they only see a white screen. The ticket has been assigned to Technical Support for investigation.
DRAFT REPLY: Thank you for bringing this to our attention. Our Technical Support team is looking into the issue and will provide an update as soon as possible. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

SUMMARY: The ticket has been escalated to the Security Team due to the customer's request for urgent attention.
DRAFT REPLY: Thank you for bringing this to our attention. Your ticket has been escalated to the Security Team for immediate review. We will get back to you as soon as possible.

SUMMARY: The customer has informed that the problem is fixed and is requesting to close the ticket. No further action is needed from the support team.
